gaps.note: The Nest pages only list the files (root module, controller, service) and the bootstrap; they do not explain decorators, DI, providers, pipes, guards or DTOs.
The Express Handbook has no error middleware (4 arguments), express.Router, helmet, CORS, JWT/passport.
Fastify: hooks and decorators appear only in passing (p.7, p.10); no lifecycle, no pino/logging beyond logger: true, no TypeScript, prefixes or security plugins.
The Node Handbook (2018) does not cover worker threads, cluster, child_process, crypto, Buffer, ESM as the default, the native test runner, debugging, npm audit/ci, pnpm, Docker or TypeScript.
REST API design belongs to web-api-rest-architecture-expert; ORMs/Postgres/Mongo (beyond MySQL p.193-197 and @fastify/mongodb) and authentication beyond sessions are not in the sources.
Out of scope: React/Next/Vue are handled by other agents (Next.js is only cited as a name on p.6 of the Node Handbook).
